issue.title: Remove archive-scale dismissed-bundle setup from the fast test lane
issue.description: Test-suite scaling audit on 2026-08-05 measured three unmarked default-lane tests in tests/test_dismissed_bundle_persistence.py at 88.62 s total in focused serial execution: test_save_dismissed_bundle_is_fast_with_many_existing_bundles 52.33 s, test_bundle_no_limit 27.92 s, and test_bundle_save_does_not_leak_index_file_descriptors 6.58 s. The four-worker full run measured 64.09 s, 30.24 s, and 8.03 s. Only 8 of 25,915 collected tests are currently marked slow, so these archive-scale loops materially delay every agent check. No existing task or active epic covers this. Scope: preserve the behavioral/performance assertions while constructing the pre-existing archive directly or through a bulk fixture instead of invoking the production save path hundreds/thousands of times; if irreducible, classify them in a performance/slow lane excluded from the normal agent fast check.
